name: ALL PLAYS
description:
ALL PLAYS helps youth sports teams coordinate the season from one app.

Coaches, team administrators, parents, and players can:
• View team schedules, games, and practices
• Manage RSVPs and availability
• Follow live scores, game updates, and recorded results
• Communicate through team messages
• Manage rosters and player information
• Share schedules and game information with family
• Access team media, registration, fees, and game-day tools according to their role

Sign in to see the teams and tools connected to your account. Permissions keep administrative actions limited to authorized team staff.
